blocks.html: You do not need R, or any other software, to read this book. Every idea, calculation and Checkpoint can be followed without a computer, and no section depends on an In R box. The boxes are there for readers who want to run the analyses themselves. They use small synthetic teaching datasets that behave like real community-medicine data; no row describes a real person, household or village. If you want to try them, §1.6 includes a short R primer, and Appendix B lists every R function used, with the sections where it appears. On a first reading you can skip every In R box and Appendix B.
